title: Towards an enzyme cascade synthesis of the bulk chemical acrylic acid
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 21 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75484-w

Acrylic acid is a bulk chemical produced via fossil-based processes. Here the authors repurpose a thiamine diphosphate (ThDP)-dependent enzyme to catalyze $${{{\rm{H}}}}_{2}{{{\rm{PO}}}}_{4}^{-}$$ H2PO4− elimination from dihydroxyacetone phosphate for acrylic acid synthesis and establish a methanol-to-acrylic acid pathway.

title: High-throughput antigen discovery using Functional Genomic Vaccinology (FGV) identifies protective Streptococcus pneumoniae vaccine candidates
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 21 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75848-2

To aid vaccine development against Streptococcus pneumoniae, the authors report a high-throughput antigen discovery platform integrating genome-wide antigen prediction, proteome-scale screening, and experimental immunogenicity validation.

title: Giant nonlinear Hall effect in isospin symmetry broken bilayer graphene
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 20 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75919-4

Spontaneous isospin symmetry breaking can strongly influence quantum nonlinear transport. Here, the authors observe a giant nonlinear Hall conductivity in dual-gated Bernal bilayer graphene that manifests strongly in a field-driven isospin polarized phase.

title: Transversal fault tolerant distributed quantum computing operations
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 20 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75693-3

Scalable quantum computers may be built by linking smaller modules, but errors on the connections pose a challenge. Here, authors simulate fault-tolerant operations across noisy links, showing distributed quantum computing can achieve very low error rates and guiding future hardware design.

title: Improving thermal shock resistance of segmented thermoelectric devices via metal foam integration
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 20 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75761-8

This work proposes a Ni foam composite solder layer, which not only optimizes the solder’s thermal expansion coefficient but also exhibits substantial plastic deformation during thermal shock, synergistically mitigating interfacial thermal stress.

title: Ligand relay catalysis enables asymmetric migratory dearomative annulation of N-heteroarenes
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 20 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75769-0

Despite their importance in ligand development, functional materials, and drug discovery, chiral N-spiroheterocycles remain challenging synthetic targets. Here, the authors report a cobalt-catalyzed asymmetric migratory dearomative annulation of electron-deficient N-heteroarenes enabling streamlined access to these frameworks.

title: Unlocking solar-derived CO<sub>2</sub> conversion to hydrocarbons over plasmonic Cu-Fe tandem catalysts under industrially relevant conditions
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 20 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75764-5

Solar-derived conversion of CO2 into hydrocarbons offers a sustainable alternative to mitigate carbon emissions but achieving efficient C-C coupling under photothermal conditions remains challenging. Here, we report a potassium-promoted Cu2Fe1 tandem catalyst that enables highly selective CO2-to-hydrocarbons conversion under industrially relevant conditions.

title: Quantitative Prediction of Exchangeable Proton Chemical Shifts
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 20 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75743-w

The authors develop a framework integrating machine-learning molecular dynamics with the ShiftML3 machine-learning shielding mode to accurately predict NMR chemical shifts of exchangeable protons in solution, outperforming DFT approaches in capturing solvation effects.
